title: "rugby_module"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

URC_players <- read.csv("phoebechar/rugby/module/URCplayers.csv")

URC_players <- URC_players |> filter(Position %in% c("Prop", "Hooker", "Lock", "Scrum-half", "Fullback"))
```


```{r}
URC_players <- URC_players |> mutate(prop_ind = if_else(Position == "Prop", 1, 0), hook_ind = if_else(Position == "Hooker", 1, 0), lock_ind = if_else(Position == "Lock", 1, 0))
```

Above, 3 of the 4 indicator variables are defined. Define the 4th one (an indicator for scrum-half).

```{r}
URC_players <- URC_players |> mutate(scrum_ind = if_else(Position == "Scrum-half", 1, 0))
```

```{r}
modPos = lm(Weight ~ Height + prop_ind + hook_ind + lock_ind + scrum_ind, data = URC_players)

summary(modPos)
```
